constraints: Fix only defects confirmed by 2/2 adversarial verifiers with low fix risk
No breaking changes to tool response shapes
context: Fixed 6 confirmed high-severity defects: assemble ordering, resolved-obligation leak, silent warning drop, why() retired statuses, ingest data loss, reverse-migrate wipe
rationale: archived is equally non-authoritative and was missing from both the filter and WHY_STATUS_RANK, so adding only the reported status would have left the same class of bug in place
summary: Chose to widen why()'s exclusion to a WHY_RETIRED_STATUSES set covering superseded, overridden and archived rather than adding 'overridden' alone
